programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Joni's hoarding drove her two sons to turn to drugs to cope, and it forced Child Protective Services to take her granddaughter away from her.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: A victim of abuse as a child, Diana's hoarding became so extreme that her daughter was forced to sleep in a recliner because the trash had overtaken her room.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Tami is battling cancer and her last hope for survival is a bone marrow transplant. But the condition of her home is getting in the way of her treatment.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: John is a retired corrections officer living in a house with more than 30 cats hiding in the walls and ceilings. They run wild through most of the home and all surfaces are covered with cat feces and urine.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: This one-hour special updates viewers on what has happened to five of our hoarders one year after they received crisis assistance from the HOARDERS Team.
programme.sub-title: Season #3 Follow-up: Vula, Al, Jim, Arline, Glen

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Every room in Phyllis' house is packed with dolls. Her obsession has manifested itself into a floor-to-ceiling collection of bags stuffed with dolls.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Linda's family has been ripped apart by hoarding.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Mary Lynn's 14 year-old-son Jacob would rather be in foster care than live with his own mother in her hoarded house.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Roy is facing $20 million in fines from the county for hoarding hundreds of vehicles on his property.

programme.title: Hoarders

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Lisa is an active chef, a member of various cooking groups, an expert on historical cooking gadgets -- and a compulsive food hoarder.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Two hoarders are living in life threatening conditions. Cynthia has a debilitating auto immune disease and lives in a hoard that could make her illness deadly.

programme.desc: A gifted mechanic, Tyler, 26, worked in the family business with his brother, Zach, and his sister, Ashley.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Jimbo's addiction to painkillers has already resulted in a devastating injury and a strained relationship with his devoted dad.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Gina is bright, fun-loving, and ambitious, but she's losing a difficult battle with drugs and compulsive gambling.

programme.desc: When Caroline and Richard bicker over their shared work space, Caroline finds the perfect solution when she purchases an antique partner's desk from the desk's original owners, writing and life partners Vic Stansky and Stella Dawson.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Bad Date
programme.desc: Annie re-introduces Caroline to the wonderful world of dating, by taking her on a man-hunt, but when Caroline thinks she has met the perfect man, she later finds that he's no love connection.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Proposal
programme.desc: When Del surprises Caroline (Lea Thompson) with a marriage proposal, Richard (Malcolm Gets) feels he no longer fits into Caroline's life and decides it's time to look for another job.

programme.title: Caroline in the City: Caroline And The Ex-Wife
programme.desc: When Del (Eric Lutes) takes Caroline (Lea Thompson) on a spontaneous weekend trip, they unexpectedly run into Del’s bitter ex-wife Jill (guest star Joely Fisher) and her boyfriend Blair (guest star Kenny Johnson).

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Odd Couples
programme.desc: Oscar and Felix seek the advice of a counselor in their apartment building to help overcome their issues.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Felix Navidad
programme.desc: When Felix learns that his perfectionist mother Meredith (Jessica Walter) cannot host Christmas this year, he goes into a frenzy as he prepares to take over the Unger family Christmas traditions.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: To avoid a night of boredom, Oscar suggests that Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) take Felix out on their artsy cultural dates in his place.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Should She Stay or Should She Go?
programme.desc: Felix meets a fun-loving woman, Natasha (Busy Phillips), in a bar and takes her home for what is meant to be a one-night stand.
programme.sub-title: Should She Stay or Should She Go?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school
programme.sub-title: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Morgan Geyser and Anissa Weier attempt to kill a classmate, inspired by Slender Man.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Brittney Dwyer, obsessed with American Horror Story, kills her grandfather for over $100k in savings.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Luka Magnotta confesses to murder online, inspired by Basic Instinct, sparking a manhunt.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Matt Baker turns his friends into a real-life mob after being inspired by Casino.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: A Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: It’s an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a shortcut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can’t believe his eyes.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Fighting for the Truth
programme.desc: An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife, and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: False Impressions
programme.desc: As each lead turns cold in a gruesome murder case, Dr. G worries justice may never be served. As the autopsy draws to an end, Dr. G uncovers a shocking clue that may solve this crime.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Dark Waters
programme.desc: A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Body Burn
programme.desc: A bipolar man's family fears he took his own life and turn to Dr. G for closure. At autopsy, Dr. G makes a shocking discovery that threatens to turn the whole case upside down.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman
programme.desc: Golightly conned tens of thousands of dollars from men she found in lonely hearts columns and dating sites.
programme.sub-title: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hendy-Freegard – The Terrorist Trickster
programme.desc: Dubbed “The Most Evil Conman Ever” by the British press, Hendy-Freegard terrorized victims into believing they were terrorist targets.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Gene Morrison – Fraudulent Forensics Expert
programme.desc: He faked his own credentials and netted $400,000 of taxpayers money, giving bogus court testimony and investigative services.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Angel of Death
programme.desc: An angel of mercy turns out to be an angel of death when the number of deaths in an Indiana Intensive Care Unit skyrockets. One astute nurse believes there must be more to this than just natural causes.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Bull's Eye
programme.desc: A Girl Guide leader is found dead on the floor of her bedroom. When an autopsy reveals a bullet lodged in her brain, detectives learn they’re investigating a murder.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Who Killed Santa?
programme.desc: In 2001, there are a series of murders of homeless people in Toronto. The latest killing is of a gentle man, well known in the area by residents who nicknamed him Santa Claus.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Danger in the Woods
programme.desc: Three teenagers accompany a deliveryman to a densely wooded area for a drinking party that, before long, becomes a nightmare. Things take a terrifying turn when one of teens attacks the others.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Faith Healer
programme.desc: A trucker at a roadside rest station discovers the fully clothed body of a dead East Indian woman.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Loch Ness Monster
programme.desc: In 1998, in a normally peaceful suburb, a pervert on a bicycle appears, performing sexual acts on himself and then attacking teenage girls. For reasons apparent to the residents, they nickname him after the Scottish Loch Ness monster.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Game
programme.desc: 1995 - Houston, Texas. A lonely man calls a dating service and gets more than he bargained for when he is met at gunpoint and robbed by his “dates”. The women, dubbed “Thelma & Louise”, lure men with the promise of sex but then drug and rob them.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Cold Hit
programme.desc: In 1994, a troubled single mother is found raped and murdered in her apartment. Was it one of the volatile men in her life? All possible suspects are eliminated and the case goes cold for three years, until a nine-year old girl is brutally raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Ghost
programme.desc: A cunning arsonist stays one step ahead of the police and terrifies a small farming community until behavioural profiling help detectives zero in on a very unlikely suspect.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Nightmare
programme.desc: Every woman’s worst nightmare comes to life when a bearded sexual predator starts attacking women in the safety of their own apartments while they are sleeping.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Bella must choose between Edward and Jacob amid a string of mysterious killings and a malicious vampire's quest for revenge.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
programme.desc: A chain of events, set off by Edward and Bella's marriage, honeymoon and birth of a child, yields a shocking development for Jacob.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
programme.desc: Bella and Edward gather werewolves, vampires and other allies to help them protect their daughter from the Volturi.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: After being committed for 15 years, Michael Myers escapes from the mental institution and immediately returns to Haddonfield to find his baby sister, Laurie.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: Laurie Strode struggles to come to terms with her brother Michael's deadly return to Haddonfield, Illinois; meanwhile, Michael prepares for another reunion with his sister.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Two people (Tom Atkins, Stacey Nelkin) discover that a TV commercial will cue a madman's (Dan O'Herlihy) Halloween masks to explode.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: While trying to convince a disgraced ex-cop (Sam Worthington) to come in from a high-rise ledge, a police negotiator (Elizabeth Banks) begins to realize that the man has an ulterior motive.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: An expert (Sylvester Stallone) in prison security joins forces with an inmate (Arnold Schwarzenegger) to break out of a top-secret, high-tech facility.

programme.title: Now You See Me
programme.desc: A federal agent (Mark Ruffalo) and an Interpol detective (Mélanie Laurent) play a cat-and-mouse game with cunning illusionists who rob corrupt business leaders during their performances, then funnel the money to members of the audience.

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Raisins: When Wendy breaks up with Stan he takes it hard. The boys decide to take him to the restaurant Raisins, where all of the employees are preteen girls who enjoy wearing heavy make-up. (S7, E14)

programme.title: South Park: It's Christmas In Canada
programme.desc: It's Christmas In Canada: A law is passed in Canada, meaning poor lil' Ike must return to his biological parents. The boys set out to stop this but who is the evil mastermind behind the law? (S7, E15)

programme.title: South Park: Good Times with Weapons
programme.desc: Good Times With Weapons: After buying martial arts weapons at a local flea market, the boys are transformed into anime Japanese Warriors, with dire consequences for poor Professor Chaos. (S8, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: AWESOM-O
programme.desc: AWESOM-O: When Cartman disguises himself as a robot in order to play a prank on Butters, he ends up being used by movie execs to come up with film ideas and captured by the military! (S8, E05)

programme.title: South Park: Up the Down Steroid
programme.desc: Up The Down Steroid: Jimmy is due to take part in the Special Olympics but what dodgy substance is he talked into taking? Cartman fakes being disabled so he can enter and win a $1,000. (S8, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: Goobacks: South Park is swamped by workers from the future, who take all the jobs for less pay. The men of South Park go to unusual lengths to stop them. "Dey turk err jurbs!" (S8, E07)

programme.title: South Park: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: The Jeffersons: A new family arrive in South Park with a little boy called Blanket, a fairground in the garden and a dad with a penchant for singing and cosmetic surgery. Guess who? Shamone! (S8, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Douche and Turd
programme.desc: Douche and Turd: The pupils of South Park Elementary are called to vote for a new mascot. With the choices being a "giant douche" and a "turd sandwich" is there any point? (S8, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes
programme.desc: Something Wall-Mart This Way Comes: When a mall is built in South Park, the townsfolk become addicted to shopping - it'll take the boys hunting down its evil "heart" to end their misery! (S8, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Preschool
programme.desc: Pre-School: The boys are pooping their pants after hearing that Trent, a notorious bully from their pre-school years, is being released from juvenile hall - guess who put him there? (S8, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Quest for Ratings
programme.desc: Quest For Ratings: When the gang's school news programme trails far behind Craig's show, "Animals Close-Up With a Wide-Angle Lens", they pledge to boost their ratings - how far will they go? (S8, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset
programme.desc: Stupid Spoiled ***** Video Playset: Paris Hilton opens a store in South Park, corrupting the town's girls in the process. It's up to Mr Slave to put things right - time for a "***** off!" (S8, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Cartman's Incredible Gift
programme.desc: Cartman's Incredible Gift: Cartman jumps off his roof while wearing cardboard wings and ends up in a coma. When he awakens he believes he has psychic powers - and the police believe it too! (S8, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Woodland Critter Christmas
programme.desc: Woodland Critter Christmas: Stan finds talking animals building a Christmas tree in the woods. They enlist him to protect them from an evil mountain lion but things aren't what they seem. (S8, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrison's Fancy New Vagina
programme.desc: Mr Garrison's Fancy New Vagina: Mr Garrison has a sex change, Kyle has an unusual operation to make him tall and athletic enough to play basketball and Kyle's dad has "dolphinoplasty"!?! (S9, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Die Hippie, Die
programme.desc: Die Hippie, Die: Cartman runs a 'pest control' service to rid the town of hippies and is soon arrested, but when a plague of hippies invades South Park the town turn to him and his methods. (S9, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Wing
programme.desc: Wing: The boys become talent agents to make an easy buck. They take on a Chinese lady named Wing and are soon confronted by the Chinese mafia, looking for a slice of the action. Fight! (S9, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Best Friends Forever
programme.desc: Best Friends Forever: Kenny is in a coma. Cartman wants life-support turned off so he can get his PSP. But Kenny's spirit is leading the armies of heaven against the demons of hell! (S9, E04)

programme.title: South Park: The Losing Edge
programme.desc: The Losing Edge: The boys are bored of playing baseball, and concoct a plan to lose the big play-off game. Randy trains hard to become the biggest drunken jackass at each match. (S9, E05)

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba

programme.title: La Gran Aventura Del Zorro
programme.desc: Durante la colonia española en california, un grupo de hombres conduce a varios esclavos en condiciones infrahumanas, ante esto, el zorro aparece para liberarlos. El zorro oculta su identidad tras la imagen de Diego Vega, un rico heredero.

programme.title: La Sonrisa De Los Pobres
programme.desc: Julio, llega a la capital luego de estudiar mecánica automotriz. Una empresa lo contrata pero como oficinista, por lo que quiere renunciar pero resiste para estar cerca de la secretaria Lupe. Se casa con Lupe y ella se sale de trabajar.

programme.title: Las Cariñosas
programme.desc: Laura, Lola y Carmen son tres mujeres muy guapas y enfermeras de un sanatorio, que provocan que los enfermos del sexo masculino se enfermen más, para que estas bellas jóvenes sigan atendiéndoles.

programme.title: Los Barbaros Del Norte
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien según esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre. Antes de llegar, su pequeño barco se estrella en las rocas, quedando un solo sobreviviente.

programme.title: Me Gustan Todas
programme.desc: Tras recibir el consejo de su doctor de cabecera, Don Nicanor, un adinerado hombre de nacionalidad mexicana, decide ir en busca de su hija perdida Rosita, quien radica en la Habana, Cuba. Decide contratar a dos agentes para que den con su paradero.

programme.title: Mis Tres Viudas Alegres
programme.desc: México, años 50. En plena noche de bodas con su esposa Silvia, el viejo sabio José se muere. Aparecen otras viudas suyas, la cubana Amalia y la francesa Lilia. El les deja 60 millones de pesos a estas a cambio de que encuentren a un hijo.

programme.title: Piernas De Oro
programme.desc: En una carrera de bicicletas, Clavillazo vence a Esteban quien siempre había sido el campeón municipal. El coronel García ordena que formen una cuarteta con Clavillazo. Esteban y otros, para correr en la vuelta al centro de la república.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Angelitos Del Trapecio
programme.desc: Torpe y asustado Capulina se ve envuelto en una aventura en las peligrosas alturas del trapecio, todo para ayudar al triunfo de una bella trapecista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se convierte en un superhéroe llamado "El Mapache", pero aparece “Mysterion” y opaca la atención de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son víctimas de una pesada broma en el Día de los Inocentes, y las cosas no terminan de la mejor manera.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy crea la broma más graciosa de todos los tiempos, que se convierte muy popular en South Park, pero Cartman se quiere tomar la mitad del crédito.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un extraterrestre fugitivo pone en riesgo al planeta, Randy y Stan son responsables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El sueño de Cartman de ser un pirata se convierte en realidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike es atormentado por espíritus, por lo que Kyle busca la ayuda de famosos cazafantasmas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters está decidido a conseguir su primer beso para que sus amigos no se burlen de él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de asistir a su primera función de lucha libre, los niños deciden convertirse en luchadores.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos enfrentan a una pandilla de motociclistas que han perturbado la paz del pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman es elegido para dar los anuncios matutinos en la escuela y usa su cargo para atacar a Wendy.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A los chicos le dan un polémico libro para leer en la escuela y los inspira a escribir uno propio.
programme.sub-title: La historia de escroto Mc Bolas de Moco

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El restaurante favorito de Cartman ha cerrado y ha sido reemplazado por una tienda que vende marihuana medicinal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan intenta borrar su cuenta de Facebook, pero acaba envuelto en el mundo virtual de la red social. Mientras, Kyle agrega a sus amistades a un niño nada popular y comienza a perder amigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy se van a un campamento de verano con todos sus amigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toda su vida, el sueño de Cartman ha sido ser piloto de NASCAR y está dispuesto a hacer todo lo posible para que esto ocurra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan no puede parar de guardar cosas innecesarias en su armario y, al ser enviado con el Señor Mackey para tratar su problema, se da cuenta de que él consejero de la escuela tiene el mismo trastorno de acumulación compulsiva que él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mapache junto con sus amigos: Mysterion, Toolshed, Cometa-Humano, Tupper-Wear, Mosquito, Iron Maiden y Mintberry Crunch tratan de hacer el bien, pero todo se sale de control.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera identidad de Mysterions es revelada. Mientras tanto, el Coon, despreciado por sus compañeros súper héroes, está en busca de venganza, y logra convencer a Cthulu para ser compañeros de equipo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: ¡Parece que el Coon es más nefasto incluso que el Señor Oscuro, Cthulhu! Mientras que el Coon castiga a sus antiguos amigos, Kenny lucha con la maldición de su súper poderes a través de su alter ego, Mysterion.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La vida de Stan es un caos en su casa y en la escuela, y tiene que solucionarlo todo por sí mismo. Mientras tanto, el matrimonio Marsh pende de un hilo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy realiza una entrega de premios a la comedia, dando el trofeo de peores comediantes a los Alemanes los cuales, furiosos, toman represalias con un robot.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la boda real canadiense la princesa es secuestrada. Obsesionado por el casamiento real, Ike intenta resolver la situación, aunque para eso tenga que abandonar la obra de teatro de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la primaria de South Park realizan una medición para ver el crecimiento corporal de los niños, pero Cartman confunde todo y se enfurece.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters es diagnosticado con trastorno de personalidad múltiple. El propietario del restaurante chino “City Wok”, desafía a un japonés que es dueño de un nuevo restaurante llamado “City Sushi”.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan cumple 10 años y comienza a ver todo de una forma diferente. Para él, ahora todo es una mierda. Los otros chicos lo ven depresivo y se alejan de él para no ser contagiados.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman encuentra una manera única de tratar con el síndrome de Asperger. Mientras tanto, Stan no parece recuperar su vida a la normalidad, no importa cuánto se esfuerce.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los alumnos de South Park son víctimas de un nuevo sitio web de rumores escolares creado por un hacker que está publicando las historias secretas de los estudiantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy descubre que los musicales de Broadway tienen mensajes subliminales para que las mujeres complazcan a sus maridos. Por otro lado, Shelly vive una historia de amor con un niño sobreprotegido.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Por culpa de la baja puntuación en el examen de educación física de Cartman, toda la escuela tiene que renunciar a sus recesos. Indignados, el 99% de la escuela se pone en contra de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan y Kenny tienen que hacer un reporte sobre el Día de Acción de Gracias pero no leen libros y en su lugar miran el canal History Channel.

programme.desc: Un cartógrafo emprende un viaje para mapear las tierras inexploradas de Transilvania.

programme.title: El niño y la guerra

programme.title: Doble amenaza
programme.desc: Una joven con doble personalidad arrastra a un hombre a una fuga entre mafiosos.

programme.title: La premonición

programme.title: En el Rastro del Asesino
programme.desc: Un policía trabaja para averiguar si un adolescente violento asesinó a su familia.

programme.title: Rastros de Un Crimen
programme.desc: Un limpiador de casas de mediana edad se ve envuelto en un crimen violento después de ser contratado para localizar al hijo separado de un cliente.

programme.title: La Red de Corrupción
programme.desc: Liam es un ex convicto que intenta recuperar el amor y la confianza de su familia. La búsqueda de redención de Liam le llevará a una red de conspiración, crimen y corrupción.

programme.title: La Chica Muerta
programme.desc: Arden encuentra el cadáver de la joven Krista. A lo largo de cinco historias se resolverá el misterio del asesinato, descubriéndose también las carencias de muchas de las vidas que han rodeado el suceso.

programme.title: La Última Victima

programme.title: El Americano
programme.desc: Durante los intensos años 50, en Vietnam, un experimentado y anciano reportero británico disputa con un joven médico estadounidense, que en realidad es un agente secreto de la CIA, los sentimientos de una bella mujer vietnamita.

programme.title: Desaparecido

programme.title: El Golpe
programme.desc: Esa es la historia de un grupo de delincuentes de poca monta en 1975 que intentan llevar a cabo el mayor atraco en la historia de Estados Unidos: robar más de 30 millones de dólares a la mafia en el estado más pequeño de la unión, Rhode Island.

programme.title: Aceleración Máxima

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América; el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: Sin rastro (Gone)
programme.desc: La policía no la cree, así que una mujer (Amanda Seyfried) emprende en solitario la búsqueda del asesino en serie del que escapó en el pasado y que ahora cree que ha secuestrado a su hermana.

programme.title: Perdidos en el sol
programme.desc: Delincuente y huérfano roban juntos.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: A una adolescente y su familia le suceden fenómenos extraños después de haberse mudado a una casa de campo.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Un médico británico lucha contra una epidemia de cólera en un pequeño pueblo chino, mientras está atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol

programme.desc: Shing Lung (Jackie Chan) pasó toda su niñez aprendiendo el estilo secreto de Kung Fu de su abuelo. Su abuelo siempre lo advirtió de mantener el secreto del arte, pero Lung nunca rechazaba una pelea, lo que originó desastrosos resultados.

programme.title: El super chef

programme.title: Más Allá De La Onda Expansiva

programme.desc: Un arisco anciano choca con su nuera cuando, a consecuencia de una caída, tenga que trasladarse a vivir con la familia de su hijo a Helsinki. Su nuera es una mujer de carrera que no tiene tiempo para perder con un cascarrabias.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.desc: Rucio, el burro de Sancho Panza, decide contar la historia de Don Quijote. De hecho Rucio insiste en que el caballero no está tan loco y fuera de lo común como muchos piensan.

programme.desc: San Hilario vivía de su espléndido cementerio y de la habilidad de sus gentes para organizar los entierros más hermosos. La gente viajaba a San Hilario a morirse a gusto.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Nocturna
programme.desc: ¿Qué es lo que hace a la noche tan misteriosa? ¿Qué hay detrás de todas esas pequeñas cosas que hacen a la noche ser así y que parecen no tener explicacón?

programme.title: Llamada oculta
programme.desc: Un psicópata utiliza el sistema de seguridad de alta tecnología de una familia para atraparlos en su propia casa.

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: En los años 30, un periodista de investigación británico viaja a lo más profundo de la Unión Soviética para descubrir una conspiración internacional.

programme.title: Webcam de animadoras
programme.desc: Maisy se traslada a la universidad de su difunta hermana para investigar las circunstancias de su muerte.

programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: 23-F: El día más difícil del Rey
programme.desc: El 23 de febrero de 1981, un grupo de mandos militares encabezados por Antonio Tejero perpetraron un intento de golpe de Estado durante la votación del candidato a la presidencia del Gobierno, Leopoldo Calvo Sotelo, en el Congreso.

programme.title: 23-F: El día más difícil del Rey
programme.desc: El 23 de febrero de 1981, un grupo de mandos militares perpetraron un intento de golpe de Estado durante la votación del candidato a la presidencia del Gobierno, Leopoldo Calvo Sotelo. Estos mandos militares se proponen modificar la situación a su manera.

programme.title: Rebelde entre el centeno

programme.desc: El forajido Isaac LeMay está en las últimas, perseguido como un perro. Está dispuesto a acabar con todo, pero su maldición permanece. Su hijo Cal es aún peor que él, y deja un reguero de sangre y destrucción por donde pasa.

programme.desc: El colegio de South Park es víctima de una página web de cotilleos y se lía pardísima. ¿Quién le pondrá solución? ¿Cartman o Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: 1 %

programme.title: El juego de Ender

programme.title: Infinitum

programme.title: Oceans Rising

programme.title: La era del mañana

programme.title: Tentáculos de las Bermudas

programme.title: Tormenta colosal
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: On the 100th anniversary of the original voyage, a modern luxury liner christened "Titanic II," follows the path of its namesake. But when a tsunami hurls an ice berg into the new ship's path, the passengers and crew must fight to avoid a similar fate.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: The unthinkable: The unthinkable

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: El Suplicio de la Estudiante
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, de 18 años, una camarera de hotel en prácticas, desaparece después del servicio de la noche.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Abatido en Pleno Sueño
programme.desc: Disparo mientras dormía (Caso de Richard Alessandri): La noche del 16 de julio de 2000, la vida de Edwige Alessandri cambió para siempre.

programme.title: Memoria Negra: La Emparedada
programme.desc: El 11 de enero de 1977 María Dolores Santiago Palenzuela desaparece sin dejar rastro. 29 años después el caso sería resuelto tras el hallazgo de sus restos, enterrados en el sótano de un hotel de Palma que se encontraba en obras.

programme.title: Memoria Negra: Las Siete Casas
programme.desc: El cadáver del ciudadano alemán Günter Ulrich es localizado en el fondo de un pozo sellado en la finca de Las Siete Casas, al este de la isla de Mallorca.

programme.title: Memoria Negra: El Caso De Dagmar Sprenger
programme.desc: Año 1987. La aparición del cadáver de ciudadano alemán Winfred Brandt inicia una investigación que llevará a la resolución del misterioso caso de los restos humanos aparecidos en dos playas de la isla de Mallorca.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: La familia Manson
programme.desc: Dianne, una adolescente de 14 años, es seducida por la "familia" de Charles Manson. Dianne ve cómo su filosofía hippie de paz y amor se vuelve algo oscuro, peligroso y malvado. ¿Cómo sobrevivir a uno de los asesinos más enigmáticos de la historia?

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: El asesino Playboy
programme.desc: Como compañera de casa de Paul Snider, Patti ve el devastador efecto que tiene en él la ruptura con su esposa, la Playmate de Playboy Dorothy Stratten, sobre su ego frágil. Cuando Paul pierde el control, destruye la vida de Dorothy y la carrera de Patti.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: Sammy "el Toro" Gravano
programme.desc: Karen es la orgullosa hija de Sammy el Toro, un mafioso poderoso de Nueva York. Todo se derrumba cuando Sammy testifica para el gobierno y cambia la historia del crimen organizado de Nueva York. Pero no pensó en el impacto en la vida de su hija.

programme.title: Clarividentes
programme.desc: Un hombre de California encuentra a sus vecinos ancianos asesinados en su propia casa. En Ohio, la policía investiga un sangriento ataque, pero no encuentra a la víctima. Un par de psíquicos se unen para ayudar.

programme.title: Anatomía de un Crimen: El asesino de la baraja
programme.desc: Alfredo Galán Sotillo, conocido como el “asesino de la baraja”, mató a seis personas en 2003 provocando gran alarma social en Madrid. Durante 3 meses tuvo en jaque a toda la policía y acabó entregándose y confesando sus crímenes por voluntad propia.

programme.title: Belleza mortal
programme.desc: Teresa Pérez, una bella cazafortunas, cree que por fin encontró el amor junto a Justyn Rosen, un hombre casado. Cuando el rico hombre de negocios termina la relación con su joven amante, Teresa se venga de Justyn con un secuestro impactante.

programme.title: Belleza mortal
programme.desc: Amanda Logue, una madre de los suburbios aburrida de su vida, deja a su familia para ser la actriz porno, Sunny Dae. Ahí, se enamora de su co-estrella, Jason Andrews y viven un romance envuelto en drogas que termina en asesinato en una fiesta sexual.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Bombardero Loco
programme.desc: En 1996, un atacante en serie comienza a colocar bombas en lugares públicos y aterroriza a la comunidad de la Isla del Príncipe Eduardo.

programme.desc: La investigación del asesinato de un turbio hombre de negocios de Montreal lleva a los detectives al escabroso submundo de traficantes de drogas.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Avión Secuestrado

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: Oscuras intenciones

programme.title: Las apariencias

programme.title: Mutante X

Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas & Art Simmons
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade', shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big' Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines'. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues'. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris'. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks, Judith Hendricks, Kim Lindsay & Mart Ledford
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. John Carl Hendricks is one of the instigators of "vocalese", an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing. He flaunts this technique at Estival, where he "scat" while playing double bass. Hendricks is known for his mastery of scat, a form of vocal jazz that uses onomatopoeia rather than lyrics

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker
programme.sub-title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans' ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans' renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: In the not too distant future, a drifter travelling through the desert discovers the largest gold nugget ever found. He must guard it from thieves amid harsh conditions and wild dogs while waiting for his partner to return.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Set against the devastating backdrop of war-torn Liberia, The Last Face centers on a love affair between Dr. Miguel Leon, a relief-aid doctor, and Dr. Wren Petersen), the director of an international aid organization. Directed by Two-time Academy Award® winner Sean Penn.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: R. J. Mitchell, a patriotic aircraft designer, was concerned about the rise of German military power and dedicated himself to creating a defense against the German Messerschmidt, ultimately sacrificing his health. AKA The First of the Few

programme.title: Along Came the Devil
programme.desc: Growing up wasn't easy for Ashley, and in her quest for belonging, she accidentally welcomes an evil presence, leaving her family and friends in a desperate battle to save her.

programme.title: All Hallows' Eve
programme.desc: Happy Halloween. Or maybe not? On Halloween night, a babysitter looking after two kids finds an old VHS tape in their trick-or-treat bag. The tape is filled with creepy stories, all tied together by a killer clown. As the night goes on, weird things start happening around the house. Before long, the babysitter realizes something terrifying: the crazy clown from the tape is slowly becoming part of her real world. Contains very strong language and bloody violence.

programme.title: All Hallows' Eve 2
programme.desc: Happy Halloween. Or maybe not.... A woman finds a VHS tape on her doorstep that shows a series of gruesome tales that could be real. But the true danger is the pumpkin-faced killer that's using the tape to find his next victim. Contains strong language and violence.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
programme.desc: In the 1950s, Hellboy is enlisted to aid rookie paranormal researcher, Bobbie Jo Song, in the transportation of a deadly creature. However, their mission soon goes awry when an accident leaves them stranded in the forests of rural Appalachia, where a small community resides, haunted by demonic forces. With all clues pointing towards witchcraft as the culprit, Hellboy and his allies must hunt down the source of this evil - a being known as 'The Crooked Man' who has been sent to Earth to harvest souls for the devil.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: A morally upright naval hero accepts a position with the Secretary of Defense and his somewhat overzealous assistant. Things become a bit sticky when the Secretary of Defense becomes involved in the murder of a beautiful Washington, D.C. party girl.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: When evidence implicates a veteran LAPD cop in the execution of a fellow officer, he is forced to go up against the cop culture he's been a part of his entire career.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga
programme.desc: Bella is forced to choose between her love for vampire Edward and her friendship with werewolf Jacob.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga
programme.desc: The Quileutes close in on Edward and Bella, whose unborn child poses a threat to the Wolf Pack and Forks.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga
programme.desc: The Cullens gather together other vampire clans in order to protect Renesmee from a false allegation.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Michael Myers is released from a mental institution, and goes on a rampage to find his younger sister.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: Sniper Elite
programme.desc: Kevin Sorbo stars in this scorching sci-fi action film in which a squad of elite human soldiers faces down a powerful and deadly extraterrestrial army. When a top sniper from the World Defence Force, is trapped in enemy territory, his survival skills are put to the ultimate test as he takes on a battalion of Cerulean soldiers, hell bent on wiping all humans from existence.

programme.title: Redwood
programme.desc: Breakout film at Frightfest Festival and a must-watch for all horror fans! Josh and Beth visit a secluded national park for some quality time. Ignoring the advice of the Park Rangers, they venture off trail and come face to face with Redwood's legendary wildlife. A fresh spin to a well-worn mythology, creating an edge-of-your seat movie to shred your nerves and make you think twice about camping.

programme.title: Bloodthirsty
programme.desc: Frightfest Presents. Ambition can be killer. When an offer to work with one of the greatest music producers of all time comes along, singer Grey cant refuse but her new mentor isnt all that he seems to be. Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: The Farm
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. A brutal, gore-tastic slasher/survival horror, in the vein of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre and Wolf Creek. While on a road trip a couple decide to stop at a diner. Little do they know that ordering a hamburger will have terrible consequences. Their journey soon becomes a harrowing story of survival as they are kidnapped by local farmers. On their farm, humans are the main dish.

programme.title: Astronaut
programme.desc: Richard Dreyfuss stars as a lonely widower who lies about his age when entering a competition to win a trip into space

programme.title: The Bright Side
programme.desc: A stand-up comedian's life changes when she is diagnosed with breast cancer.

programme.title: Grace and Grit
programme.desc: A couple's marriage is shaken by the discovery of an illness. Together they will fight to make sense of this struggle and discover the meaning of eternal love.

Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers
programme.sub-title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: The Monty Alexander Trio
programme.sub-title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. On July 13, 1979, talented Jamaican pianist Monty Alexander was joined by Reggie Johnson (bass), Frank Gant (drums), Bobby Thomas (hand drum), and Othello Molineaux (steel drum) at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Alexander's Caribbean influences and natural flair for the piano shine through in this brilliant performance.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Turner, Kenny Clarke, Don Byas & Art Simmons
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade', shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big' Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life. From the American-owned Mars Club just off the Champs-Élysées, a hangout for showbiz people and expatriate Americans in Paris, the program cuts to the Blue Note. There, a Paris-based American quartet that includes drummer Kenny Clarke, organ player Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas performs ‘Salut Les Copines'. Returning to the Mars Club, the American jazz trio of house pianist Art Simmons (1926–2018) performs a jaunty take on ‘C-Jam Blues'. Rounding off the program at the Blue Note, the quartet of drummer Kenny Clarke, organist Lou Bennett, and tenor saxophonist Don Byas returns for a swinging ‘April in Paris'. These recordings offer an invaluable glimpse into expatriate American jazz-making in Paris in the early 1960s.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks, Judith Hendricks, Kim Lindsay & Mart Ledford
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. John Carl Hendricks is one of the instigators of "vocalese", an art form that aims to add lyrics to existing instrumental pieces and replace several instruments with singing. He flaunts this technique at Estival, where he "scat" while playing double bass. Hendricks is known for his mastery of scat, a form of vocal jazz that uses onomatopoeia rather than lyrics

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker
programme.sub-title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans' ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans' renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Klaus Tönshoff, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & DR Big Band
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus Tönshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema. Norwegian mezzosoprano Tuva Semmingsen sings ‘Diamonds Are A Girl's Best Friend', from Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, ‘My Favorite Things' from The Sound of Music, ‘Over the Rainbow' from The Wizard of Oz, ‘Moon River' from Breakfast at Tiffany's, and many other unforgettable hits. This concert performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2020.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.
